# Creator Hub Live pull request

## Purpose
What user-visible problem or engineering requirement does this change solve?

## Scope and affected paths
- [ ] Existing implementation/routes/schema/tests were inspected first.
- [ ] Only related files changed; unrelated cleanups are excluded.
- [ ] Existing working flows and compatibility are preserved.

## Risk and authorization
- [ ] Risk class recorded: R0 / R1 / R2 / R3.
- [ ] Auth, ownership, roles, RLS, privacy and abuse paths reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] Wallet/coins/diamonds/gifts/PayPal/payouts reviewed as server-authoritative and idempotent if affected.
- [ ] Production database/deployment actions are not performed without explicit approval.

## Data and compatibility
- [ ] Migration ledger/schema reconciled and backups/verification prepared if schema changes.
- [ ] API/state/event contracts and failure/retry behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Android WebView/mobile parity considered where relevant.

## Tests and evidence
- [ ] Exact automated commands and results recorded below.
- [ ] Positive and negative/unauthorized paths tested where relevant.
- [ ] Real-provider/device tests distinguished from mocked tests.
- [ ] Docs and rollback/compensation guidance updated.

**Evidence:**
- Commands and results:
- Manual routes/devices/accounts (safe test accounts only):
- PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN and blockers:

## Rollout and recovery
- [ ] Risk, monitoring signal, rollout order and rollback/compensation plan documented.
- [ ] No secrets, access tokens, signing material or unnecessary personal data added.
- [ ] No fake/demo users, balances, payments, viewers, gifts or rankings are used as real functionality.

## Owner decision
Release readiness: Ready / Hold / Not applicable. Explain blockers and next actions.
